scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @spotcheck/backend && npm run build --workspace @spotcheck/frontend && npm run build:proxy
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @spotcheck/shared && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:m3 && npm run test:m2 && npm --prefix proxy test
scripts.setup: node scripts/prepare-env.mjs && npm run db:generate && npm run build:shared
scripts.test:r1: tsx --test shared/tests/public-config.test.ts && node --test scripts/tests/check-residues.test.mjs && npm run test:r1 --workspace @spotcheck/backend
scripts.test:r2: tsx --test shared/tests/public-config.test.ts && npm run test:r2 --workspace @spotcheck/frontend && npm run test:r2 --workspace @spotcheck/backend
scripts.test:r3: npm run test:r3 --workspace @spotcheck/frontend && npm run test:r3 --workspace @spotcheck/backend && npm --prefix proxy test
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @spotcheck/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @spotcheck/backend
